description:
A hematology ward pharmacist needs to check whether ciprofloxacin (a fluoroquinolone antibiotic) can be safely co-administered with venetoclax (a BCL-2 inhibitor for CLL). Using the Liverpool Cancer iChart app which is already open:

1. Browse or scroll through the cancer drug list to find and select 'Venetoclax' (use the A-Z index if available).
2. In the co-medications list, find and select 'Ciprofloxacin' (use the A-Z index if available).
3. Observe the traffic light interaction color displayed (red, orange, yellow, green, or grey).
4. Save the interaction color as a single lowercase word to the file: /sdcard/tasks/check_antibiotic_interaction_with_venetoclax/result.txt

The result file must contain exactly one word on one line — the interaction color (e.g., 'red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'green', or 'grey'). No other text should be in the file.
